name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

description:

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

----------------------------------------

IMPORTANT Installation Note: The stock numeric keypad on some Samsung and LGE devices does not include a decimal, which makes FermCalc almost impossible to use. After you install the new keyboard, go to Settings > Language and Input, and set the new keyboard as the default keyboard. After following these steps your numeric keypad should include a decimal.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

This app can be used for a wide range of things, including:

Food products:
- Keep track of the food supplies in your fridge, pantry, and basement, and never miss an expiry date again. Get notified about low stock levels and expiring items, and replenish in time.
Clothes:
- Know what you own, so you don't end up buying duplicates or forgetting about items you already have.
Homeware:
- Keep your home organized and never misplace anything again. Know exactly where to find your tools, appliances, and other items.
Hobby collections:
- Organize your collection into categories (folders), make photos of the items, and create a convenient catalog.
Cosmetics:
- Create a list of your cosmetic products to know what you have and what you need, and never use expired products again.
Medicines:
- Keep track of your medicines and make sure you always have enough of the ones you need with a proper shelf life.

One of the most useful features of the app is the ability to add photos or images of the items in your inventory. This makes it even easier to identify and locate the items you're looking for, and helps you keep track of what you have in a more visual and intuitive way.

The app also has the ability to scan and record barcodes. If you've added a barcode to an item, you can later scan it to add or remove the item from your inventory. This makes it easy and convenient to keep track of what you have

Another key feature is the ability to share data with other people and use the app together with your family. Whether you're living with roommates, a partner, or children, this app makes it easy to collaborate and keep everyone on the same page.

Finally, the app also allows you to export your lists to Excel, giving you even more flexibility and control over your inventory and shopping processes. Whether you want to keep a backup of your data or use it in other apps and software, the option to export to Excel is a powerful and convenient feature.

We're always glad to hear your suggestions and are here to help if you need support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us at chester.help.si+homelist@gmail.com.

So why wait? Download the app today and start taking control of your inventory and shopping processes! Whether you're tracking food supplies, clothes, homeware, tools, hobby collections, cosmetics, medicines, or anything else, this app has you covered.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

Email: mbgc@tuyware.com
Reddit: www.reddit.com/r/tuyware
Facebook: www.facebook.com/tuyware

name: Board Game Stats
description:

- How many games did you play recently?

- Did you improve your score from last times?
- Use tailor-made score sheets to enter scores.

- Keep track of your collection and sync with BoardGameGeek (BGG).

Collection management features of BG Stats:
- Keep track of every game you've played or are interested in.
- Choose a specific version and image, and track multiple copies.
- Set status to Owned, Wishlist, Want to play, and much more.
- Enter details like comments, price paid, acquisition date, etc.

Play tracking features:
- Set scoring rules, cooperative and team play for each game.
- Select game and played expansions.
- Set Players and Locations, including anonymous players.
- Enter location, scores per player and many more details.
- Calculate scores on the fly by using + and - signs.
- Create teams and enter team scores.
- Use over 2500 game-specific tailor-made score sheets.
- Add Player roles, and choose from previously used ones.
- Use a timer to keep track of your play length.
- Add a Game note you can view each time you start a Play.
- Post your plays to BoardGameGeek (BGG), including auto-post after each save.
- Import existing plays from BoardGameGeek, Yucata, Board Game Arena (BGA) and ScorePal.
- Send one or more Plays to other BG Stats users so only one of you has to enter it.

Statistics features:
- View statistics for each game and player, and combination.
- See pie charts, play times and durations graphs, and score charts.
- View insights for Games and Players, for different time periods.
- See your with H-index, fives, dimes, quarters and centuries.
- View a Player's personal H-index and win percentage.
- Share Insights charts and 3x3 images.
- See cost per play for your games.

BG Stats has export and import functions for easy backup to a variety of services.
You can sync with other devices via BG Stats Cloud sync (an in-app subscription).
All in a native interface, supporting dark mode on Android 10+, landscape and tablet screens.

With the Power Expansion (in-app purchase):
- Extended game charts, based on number of players.
- Filter your data on players, locations, specific periods and player counts.
- Statistics for a specific combination of players, and compare them.
- Winning streaks, tiebreakers, and new and starting players stats.
- Role- and board-based statistics.
- Heat map of plays and play duration.
- Cost per hour, player and more.
- Add tags to Games, Players and Locations.
- Create and save custom filters, now also with tags.
- Customize the Game filter dropdown menu.
- Create advanced filters with multiple criteria and logical operations.
- View combined game statistics.
- Sync game tags with BoardGameGeek.
- Create Challenges (if available) based on game filters or tags.

With the Challenges expansion (in-app purchase):
- Create a challenge from one of the many templates.
- x times y challenges: play x games y times.
- Ongoing Reach your next H-index challenges.
- Set the time period and choose specific games to track, or use auto-fill.
- Filter specific Players, Locations and player counts to count for the challenge.

With a Cloud sync subscription:
- Seamlessly sync your data between all your devices.
- Keep a backup of your data in the cloud.

Please note that any changes to the BGG website or API can temporarily break BGG related features. I cannot guarantee their continued availability.

name: Stash - Track Video Games
description:
Welcome to Stash – the Ultimate App for Gamers!
Discover a unique blend of a gamer-focused social network and a powerful video game collection tracker – all in one app.

Stash is primarily an application for gamers. Manage and organize the games you beaten or your wishlist, set alerts for new releases and compete for the most impressive gaming collection among thousands of other gamers.

Wondered how to keep track of your gaming experiences?
Now you have the opportunity to easily discover and organize a collection and wishlist. Track and manage all of your video games, decide what to play next, and discover new games. Manage all your gaming experience across multiple platforms (PlayStation, Xbox, PC, Nintendo Switch, Steam, retro consoles and another) in one place.

👉Manage game library — Organize your games on Stash by adding them to your collection. Track what you’ve played and beat by adding games to: want, playing, beaten, archived. Let everyone know what games you’ve beaten and what’s next on your list with our collections system.

👉 Discover Games — Access the largest gaming database with more than 300k+ games available to review and add to your collections. You can find any game you know in this huge catalog! View screenshots, watch videos, and more for the games you're playing or want to play.

👉 Join gaming community — Discuss favorite and most popular games with other gamers. Share your thoughts and gain followers.

👉 Follow gamers — Check out your friends’ profiles and follow them to see their progress. Compare your gaming tastes and accomplishments. And make gamer links.

👉 Create collection — Create and manage any custom game list. Share your selection of games with the gamer community.

👉 Import Steam library — Add your game collection from Steam and conveniently browse.

👉 Leave Reviews — Share your thoughts on the game you’ve played to improve our recommendation system and mark up your favorites. Rate video games to give suggestions to other users!

👉 Set Alerts — Watching out for a huge release? We’re here for you to let you know first once it’s live. Set a reminder, and we’ll send you a push.

👉 Dominate Leaderboard — Join the fight of the most cool gamers and climb up our leaderboard to show what you’re worth.

👉 HumbleBundle Radar — Monitor new bundles from Humble. We'll let you know when a new game bundle is available.

It is your backlog app and stats tracker that can help you to organize games from all platforms.

name: Collecto - Game Tracker
description:
Stop guessing what's in your backlog. Start mastering your collection.

Collecto is the modern, lightning-fast game tracker built by collectors, for collectors. Whether you have a handful of favorite titles or a library spanning decades, our powerful tools give you the control you've always wanted. Ditch the slow spreadsheets and clunky apps—your entire video game universe is now at your fingertips.

BUILD YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

Instant Barcode Scanning: Add games to your collection in seconds. Just point your camera at the box and let Collecto do the work.

Powerful Search: Instantly find any game across multiple platforms from a massive, up-to-date database.

Manual Entry: Have a rare import or a digital-only title? Add any game manually with complete control over the details.

CATALOG WITH PRECISION

Total Control: Track everything that matters. Log the condition of the box and disc, the price you paid, and add personal notes.

Multi-Platform & Multi-Copy: Finally, a clean way to manage your library. Easily track games you own on PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, PC, and retro consoles. Own multiple copies? No problem.

Custom Tags: Create your own tagging system to organize your collection exactly how you see it. Tag games by genre, priority ("To Play Next"), status ("Completed 100%"), or anything else you can imagine.

DISCOVER & DECIDE

Deep Game Info: Access detailed descriptions, publisher info, release dates, and stunning screenshot galleries for every game.

Smart Discovery: Find hidden gems with our discovery section. Get advanced recommendations for games from the same series, franchise, or "game family" as the titles you already love.

Watchlist: Not ready to buy? Add games to your personal watchlist and keep an eye on interesting titles.

VISUALIZE YOUR COLLECTION

Advanced Statistics: Get a true sense of your gaming habits. See detailed stats based on your tags, platforms, and purchase history.

Collection Value: Curious what your library is worth? Collecto helps you track the total value of your collection based on the purchase prices you enter.

A MODERN EXPERIENCE
We believe a powerful app should also be a joy to use. Collecto features a clean, modern, and incredibly fast UI that lets you get in, get your info, and get back to gaming.

Download Collecto and take back control of your collection today!

name: Classic Board Games Collection
description:
8 Classic board games gathered in one small & simple free app. Play against the built-in computer player (Albert, the AI), or against a friend:

Backgammon: The Ancient Game of Strategy
Roll the dice and outsmart your opponent in the classic game of backgammon. "Albert" will challenge your wits and provide hours of engaging gameplay.

Chess: A Battle of Minds
Engage in the timeless battle of chess against the computer player or a friend. User-friendly interface and intuitive controls.

Othello: A Game of Reversal
Flip your way to victory in Othello, a game of strategy and cunning. Outmaneuver the computer player or your friends by strategically placing your pieces and capturing theirs, turning their strength into your advantage.

Checkers (Draughts): A Classic of Simplicity
Enjoy the timeless appeal of checkers against the computer player or a friend, a game of simple rules and surprising depth.

Domino: A Game of Chance and Skill
Test your luck and strategy in dominoes against 1 to 3 computer opponents, a game where matching numbers and blocking your opponent's moves are key to victory.

Nine Men's Morris (The Mill Game): A Game of Strategy and Blocking
Immerse yourself in the ancient game of Nine Men's Morris against the computer player or a friend, where blocking your opponent's pieces and forming mills is essential for success.

Offline Play and More
Enjoy your favorite board games anytime, anywhere, with our offline play feature. No need for an internet connection, just pick up your device and start playing. One-player or two-player options. This small app takes up very little space on your device. It also includes a couple of arcade games for added entertainment.

No Registration, No In-App Purchases
Dive into the world of board games without any hassle. Our app is free to download and play, with no registration or in-app purchases required.

Embrace the Timeless Charm of Board Games in One App! Indulge in a nostalgic journey with our Board Games Collection, a treasure trove of classic table games brought to life in a single app. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a curious newcomer, our collection offers something for every board game enthusiast.

Based on the popular browser games from Playpager.com

Scored uses the proven Elo rating algorithm (K-factor: 32, starting rating: 1000). Win against higher-rated players? Big ELO gains. Lose to lower-rated players? Bigger drops. It's fair, transparent, and competitive - just like real sports rankings.

name: Playgroup - Commander Tracker
description:
Please note: One person in your playgroup has to download and install the Playgroup life tracker app on a phone, tablet or run it on PC. The tracker app is exclusively used for tracking games. Stats will be available in real-time on the website (playgroup.gg). Optionally you can all install the app and sync the game state between devices with Playgroup Device Sync.

Ever wanted to know whether you are the best EDH player in your Playgroup? Whether that friend of yours really does take 10 minutes turns? Wondering what your average damage per game is for your favorite deck?
You'll need to track life during your games anyway enhance your experience by using the Playgroup Tracker App and get answers to all of the above questions and much more.

Playgroup requires a Playgroup.gg account to keep track of all your statistics and can't be used without it.

Main Features:

+ The life counter is available on IOS/Android/Windows/Linux or in your browser. Works on mobile, tablet and pc!
+ Supports up to 6 players
+ Don't just track wins and losses, but track how much damage has been done by which player and to which player, track turn duration and of course commander damage and poison counters.
+ Intuitive UI: By using a combination of swiping gestures (swipe towards the player that you want to damage) and tapping (tap for 1 life or hold for 10 life) tracking takes little effort.
+ Player profiles: each player loads up their personal player profile into the life counter easily via QR code. Select your deck from your deck list and start tracking!
+ Backgrounds: the life counter automatically sets your Commander as your background.

Dashboard (https://playgroup.gg) Features:

+ Personalised stats: Get detailed statistics about your deck's performance. See the power level, win rate, elo rating, average kills per game, largest kill & win streaks and much more.
+ Playgroup management: create and manage playgroups, invite an unlimited number of friends.
+ Leaderboards: Get competitve, and rank against your playgroup members with the deck or player leaderboards.

Playgroup is still under active development so be sure to drop by our Discord (https://discord.gg/wAG8aApDU5) and give your feedback and ideas for new features!

name: Secret Shuffle
description:
A party game for 4 or more players who are all in the same room wearing headphones. Kind of like silent disco, but with games!

The Secret Shuffle app synchronizes the music to up to 60 (!!) players so you can play one of 10 games together:
- Split: half of the players dance to the same music – find each other.
- Fakers: guess what player doesn't hear any music but is faking it. (This is the most popular game in our app; a social deduction game known as ‘mafia dance’ among Kpop fans!)
- Pairs: find the one other player dancing to the same music.
- Statues: freeze when the music pauses.
… and many more!

The games are fun to play with friends, coworkers, family, colleagues, and even with strangers as an icebreaker. Each of the game’s rules are explained right before a round starts, so even if some in your party are young humans or very old humans, we're fairly certain they'll figure it out. Make sure to player Fakers as it's generally people's favorite game – and if you're daring, try out the slightly more challenging game Fakers++.

Music in Secret Shuffle comes in the form of 'music packs'. Streaming services unfortunately wouldn't allow us to stream music to our app, but we're certain there's something for everyone in the music packs we designed. The app contains more than 20 music packs including:
- genre packs with hip hop, disco, rock, and many more.
- era packs with music from the 60s, 80s, and 90s.
- world packs with music from Europe, US, UK, and Latin America
- various seasonal packs such as a Halloween and Christmas pack.

The free version of Secret Shuffle includes:
- 3 games: Split, Pairs, and Groups.
- 1 music pack: Mixtape: My First.

The full version of Secret Shuffle, which is unlocked when you or anyone in your party has purchased the ‘Unlock Everything For Everyone’ in-app purchase, includes:
- 10 games: Split, Fakers, Pairs, Leader, Groups, Statues, Possessed, Fakers++, Tree Huggers, and Speaker.
- 20+ music packs: 3 mixtape packs, 4 world tour packs, 3 era packs, 4 genre packs, 3 sound effect packs, and various seasonal and holiday packs.
- All future games and music pack updates.
- Advanced options to make rounds longer, play more rounds in a single game, and disable the explanation at the start of each game.

Secret Shuffle requires all players to download the app, wear headphones, and stay connected to the internet. You’ll also need between 4 and 60 players to play any of the games.

name: Arranger NETFLIX
description:

Solve your way through a charming world packed with clever tactical tile puzzles on a quest to find somewhere you fit in, and connect the quirky communities you discover.

Explore a different kind of RPG: a "role-puzzling" game. The story unfolds through a unique, interconnected grid that spans the entire world. When you move, the colorful environment moves with you — creating a playful sense of chaos and a regular stream of small, thoughtful puzzles that twist and play with the central mechanic.

Jump into the adventure as Jemma, a small-town misfit on a journey of self-discovery. Travel beyond your stiflingly cozy confines to find an inspiring world — yet one that’s ruled by fear and a strange, immovable static force. Can you shake up a culture of stagnation and find a place to belong?

A COLORFUL, CONNECTED WORLD

• A unique gameplay grid seamlessly unites combat and exploration. Meet a cast of quirky characters, vanquish monsters and discover surprises as you move through the world.

• Swipe to slide up, down, left and right. Objects within the same row or column as you will move when you move, creating a wide variety of interesting puzzles.

CLEVER YET ACCESSIBLE GAMEPLAY

• There's no XP or inventory to manage in this breezy puzzle RPG. All game objects exist on the grid, and you maneuver them into place as you move through.

• A straightforward quest log gives you one goal at a time. In-game assist options can point you in the right direction and let you skip puzzles, so you only get as stuck as you want to be.

AN ALL-STAR DEVELOPMENT TEAM

• This is the debut game from a team of indie developers including the artist behind "Braid," the designer of "Ethereal" and the writer of "Carto."

- Created by Furniture & Mattress.

Please note that the Data Safety information applies to information collected and used in this app. See the Netflix Privacy Statement to learn more about information we collect and use in this and other contexts, including at account registration.

On "Best Guess Live," anyone can win. You just need one right answer at the right moment to claim your share of a prize money jackpot worth thousands. Get ready to think fast, because you'll be in a nationwide race to be one of the first to figure out the riddle.

A NEW DAILY ROUTINE
The game streams live in the app every weekday (Monday through Friday) at 8 PM ET | 5PM PT. The broadcast is in English, and the game is open to players anywhere in the United States.

FUN FACTS; REAL MONEY
Got a brain packed with random trivia? Put it to good use: For each round, you'll need to figure out what secret item is hidden inside a misty and mysterious crystal ball. It could be a person, place, or thing — anything!

THINK IN RIDDLES
For each round, you'll get a series of five clues hinting at the answer. Every clue will build on the previous ones, starting out cryptic and gradually getting more obvious. After each clue, you'll have time to submit an answer. But don't risk it until you think you're right, since you only get one chance per round.

BE FAST TO BE FIRST
The sooner you get the answer, the better your odds of winning. Everyone who gets the correct answer on the earliest clue for a round will evenly split the jackpot. For example, if no one gets it after the first clue, and then you're one of three people to get it after the second clue, you'll get 1/3 of the prize.

TWO CHANCES TO WIN
Each livestream includes two rounds, and the second will be harder than the first — with a bigger prize to match. If the first crystal ball mystery stumped you, jump back in and try again!

Participation open to legal residents of the 50 United States and D.C., 18+. Void where prohibited. Access to a Netflix account and a PayPal account required for participation and prize fulfillment. • Play Life and Death, Tesuji, or Endgame problems

• If you make mistakes, your rating falls and you'll get easier problems

AI PLAY

ONLINE PLAY

name: Thrift Store Story
description:
Become the manager of a pre-loved goods store (yup, that's just a fancy name for second-hand!) and turn it into a prospering business!

There are many towns for you to operate in, each with a unique customer base and different products for you to discover. You can guess what you'll find in Trendy Town or Totaltoys District, for example!

The product line-up at your store is up to you, of course. Will you be selling model toys, video games, classy suits, cars, plasma TVs, or diamonds? That's the fun in the second-hand retail industry -- you sell all sorts of goods, cherry-picked from a variety of available pre-owned products.

Your store also offers a gift-wrapping service which does wonders for boosting customer satisfaction.

Besides store shelves, you can also have stalls selling donuts or ice-cream, a gaming corner or toy vending machine. They'll draw in more customers, and once your store becomes really popular, even whole groups of kids or curious tourists.

Your field staff are in charge of collecting goods for sale. They'll sometimes come across what looks like real treasure, but you'll have to appraise it first to see what it's actually worth. You may discover some amazing items this way, which will bring fame to your store!

Fully exploring every town and finding all available products is a real challenge... Are you up for it?

  • Cloud backups and Google Drive sync
  • Web dashboard - view and export data from a desktop browser
  • Role-based permissions - control what each user can do
  • NFC write and read - tap to identify products instantly

Typical workflows

  • Receiving - scan incoming items into the right location
  • Picking and packing - verify items by barcode before shipping
  • Adjustments - correct counts after audits or returns with reason codes
  • Transfers - move stock between warehouses or rooms with traceability

Why offline matters

Counting in back rooms, warehouses, or remote sites often means spotty connectivity. Mobile Inventory records every scan locally and keeps you working. When a connection is available, changes sync automatically.

Privacy and reliability

  • Your data remains yours - export anytime to Excel, CSV, or PDF
  • Daily backups and detailed change history help prevent data loss

Get started in minutes

  1. Create an inventory and locations
  2. Import or add products with SKUs and barcodes

name: Recipe Calculator
description:
The Kitchen Calculator app by MyKitchenCalculator.com is a tool that includes a recipe converter (recipe multiplier), cooking references, and several conversion calculators that help you easily convert between the most common measuring units used in cooking and baking.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

name: Useful Units Recipe Converter
description:
SCAN RECIPE. INSTANT UNIT CONVERSION. BOOM!

The Useful Units Recipe Converter scans digital or printed recipes, automatically recognizes the text and converts the amounts of the ingredients into your preferred units, including volume to weight conversions.

"Finally: The app I always wanted and never found." Susanne Tobler, Founder & Owner of TASTELAB
_________________________


Confused by cups, ounces, pints and pinches?
Don't own a scale and want to do everything by volume? 
Here comes the solution to all your cooking unit conversion issues!

Simply take a picture from a cookbook or a screenshot from a digital source - and the app does all the work for you: it automatically reads the recipe and instantly converts it into your preferred units. 

Unlike many other recipe unit converters, Useful Units is smart and also knows about the specific weight of many ingredients. This way, you can convert between volumes and weights seamlessly!


KEY FEATURES:


RECIPE SCANNER & AUTOMATIC TEXT RECOGNITION

A recipe in cookbook or on your favourite blog? Useful Units isn’t picky: Take a picture of the recipe or just load a screenshot of it. Text recognition is automatic! Adjusting or adding ingredients manually is super easy, too.


USEFUL UNITS - TAILORED TO YOU

We all have our favourite units.
Grams, milliliters or liters? Sure.
Cups, pints and pounds? Yes.
Pinches, dashes and drops? Yep, that as well.
Choose the units you like best - and switch between them super easily!


FOREVER FREE

Useful Units is for free and always will be. Of course: You can tip us - as much or as little as you like.


ALL THE UNITS

Currently, the Useful Units Recipe Converter recognizes the following units with most of their common abbreviations:

* Units of Volume: Liters (as well as deciliters, centiliters and milliliters), tablespoons, teaspoons; drops, pinches and dashes as well as sticks (for all things buttery). Furthermore US and Imperial fluid ounces, gills, cups, pints, quarts and gallons.
* Units of Weight: Kilograms (as well as grams and milligrams), pounds, slugs and ounces.

If you think that’s not enough: Let us know!
If you think that’s too many: Never mind! Just don’t select them in the menu and they won't be displayed!


INGREDIENTS DATABASE

Is a cup of salt heavier than a cup of flour? Certainly so!

The Useful Units Recipe Converter knows the density (yay, science!) of more than 300 of the most common baking and cooking ingredients, so you don’t have to worry about these things when converting.

What about all the other ingredients? No problem: Just tell the app what category it belongs to and the app will do the rest for you.


SCALING YOUR RECIPE

Double or quadruple the recipe’s amounts? Sure, just a click.
Throwing a giant party with food for everyone? Great! Just enter your custom scaling factor and that’s it!


LANGUAGES

The Useful Units app is written completely in English.
Yet, it does recognize English and German recipes, units and ingredients.
Would you like to help teaching the app further languages? Get in touch!


We hope this neat little app brings you as much joy while cooking and baking as it does to us!

We are very interested in your feedback. If you have any inputs, questions or concerns, please contact us at app@tastelab.ch.


Cook and bake away! Sue & Remo

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

User-friendly and completely anonymous: the integrated medicine reminder will notify you whenever it’s time to take your pills, tablets, and other meds, making your daily activities much simpler. Now for measurements and activities as well, including graphs and statistics showing everything at a glance.

Developed by patients, for patients
The TOM medication reminder with the integrated medicine list and medication log is so practical and user-friendly because its developers know from personal experience which requirements a digital medication tracker and scheduler need to meet. The pill reminder is the ideal solution for simply and efficiently managing treatment regimens for a wide range of conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, Crohn’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, cardiovascular diseases, multiple sclerosis, and more.

Key features of the medical alert app at a glance
• Easy to use thanks to dialogue-based design: TOM asks and you reply – without filling in forms or having to tediously search through menus
• Add new meds, measurements, or activities quickly and easily
• Send or print PDFs of monthly health reports
• Medication log and medicine list with high-quality graphs and statistics for all pills taken, health measurements, and activities
• Feature for uploading your own pictures of med packaging
• Digital cabinet provides a complete medication list that can be printed out as a PDF file
• Pill reminder with alarm to refill prescriptions before they run out or expire
• Fully integrated treatment management that combines a record of meds you have taken with your health measurements (blood pressure and weight, for example) and activities (running, yoga, etc.)

• Suitable for managing the treatment of a wide range of conditions and diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, multiple sclerosis, stroke, asthma, etc.)
• Modern solution for managing medicine in order to ensure they are taken at the right time and to monitor the progress of your treatment
• Medication reminder if you forget to take your pills
• Maximum data security thanks to the anonymous use of the TOM pill reminder and two-way encryption

Privacy and data protection are top priority
Using the TOM medication tracker and scheduler is completely anonymous: no registration with personal details is required. The information you enter is linked only to a randomly generated ID number. Even TOM does not have access to this number, as it is also cryptographically protected. In addition, all communication with the TOM app is encrypted in both directions.

Download the TOM medication reminder on your smartphone and let the simple medication tracker and scheduler add some extra freedom to your daily life. Never forget to take your tablets, pills, or medicine again thanks to the pill reminder and medicine tracker. Suitable for a wide range of conditions, including high blood pressure, asthma, stroke, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, etc.

Thank you for using the TOM medical alert app. Your feedback helps us to further develop the TOM medication reminder and offer you maximum benefit. We always encourage you to send your suggestions and ideas to support@tommedications.com.

name: MyRxProfile: Pill & Drug Guide
description:
Using the MyRxProfile drug interaction checker, you can scan prescription (Rx) or over-the-counter (OTC) medications into your profile. The app flags when different medications share similar ingredients or serve the same purpose, bringing them to your attention. MyRxProfile promptly detects active ingredients in your medications and alerts you to potential adverse drug reactions and known side effects.

Drug reactions can range from mild and tolerable to severe and life-threatening. Understanding the nature of these adverse events helps you make appropriate interventions or adjustments to your medication regimen.

Adverse drug interactions are the fourth leading cause of death in America. In today’s healthcare environment, you are often responsible for your own safety. You may see multiple specialists who are unaware of each other’s prescriptions, and you might not have a single primary care provider or pharmacist to guide you. This is where the MyRxProfile medication interaction app becomes invaluable.

You can customize the timing and frequency of dose alerts to prevent accidental overconsumption or missed doses. These alerts serve as proactive measures to ensure consistent medication management.

MyRxProfile also offers a user-friendly interface for managing multiple family profiles, ensuring accurate tracking and monitoring of each member’s health.

Key Features

1. Adverse Drug Interaction Detection
Identify potential drug interactions and uncover risks beyond the surface.
2. Medicine Dose Reminder
Set up automated reminders to maintain consistency and prevent missed doses.
3. Drug Ingredient Tracker
Understand the ingredients in your medications and manage those that may pose health risks.
4. Medicine Scanner
Scan barcodes or medication names, or manually enter prescription details for accurate and instant information.
5. Customised Profiles
Create personalised medication profiles for each family member to simplify the management of complex regimens.
6. Past and Future Medication Tracker
Plan and monitor medication history and upcoming prescriptions for proactive management.
7. Connect with Professionals
Report health concerns or seek clarification and advice on medication management.
8. Data Security
Your data is stored securely, with a strong focus on privacy and confidentiality.

Why Choose MyRxProfile?

By centralizing medication information, analyzing drug interactions, and empowering users to take an active role in their health, MyRxProfile simplifies medication management. The app supports informed decision-making and helps improve overall health management.

Important Notes:
• MyRxProfile is a supplemental tool for medication management and does not replace professional medical advice.
• Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.

description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Psychrometric calculator - allows for psychrometric calculations.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. name: Unique: ADHD Planner & Journal
description:
Unique is an ADHD journal & planner that helps you organize tasks, build habits, and track mood - without shame or overwhelm. Use a daily journal for journaling, a habit tracker for routines, a task planner for priorities, and a mood tracker to understand patterns. You also get ADHD-friendly CBT courses and AI guided meditations to support focus, emotional balance, and follow-through.

1. ADHD journal & journaling
Open the journal, write one short line, and move on. Your journal can be messy, tiny, or detailed - journaling counts even when it’s one sentence. Use the journal to capture what’s happening in your ADHD day: distraction, procrastination, stress, motivation, energy, and wins. When your brain feels loud, journaling helps you pause and reset.

2. Mood tracker that connects to your journal
Do a quick mood check-in, then add a note in your journal. Your mood tracker makes it easy to track mood, stress, and energy in seconds. Over time, the mood tracker helps you spot patterns: how sleep, routines, habits, and tasks affect your mood. The journal + mood tracker combo turns “I feel weird” into clear signals you can use.

3. Planner, task planner & task tracker for real life
Unique is a planner built for ADHD: flexible, simple, and forgiving. Use the task planner to pick 1–3 priorities, break big tasks into small steps, and adjust when plans change. Track tasks with a task tracker mindset: what’s next, what’s done, what can wait. Your planner helps you plan today and review later—without turning planning into another task.

4. Habit tracker, habits, routines & consistency
Build habits gently with a habit tracker that supports the ADHD brain. Add one habit, set a reminder, and track progress. Turn habits into routines you can repeat daily or weekly. If you miss a day, your habit tracker helps you restart. The goal is steady habits, realistic routines, and less decision fatigue.

5. CBT courses for ADHD skills (not theory)
Unique includes CBT courses designed for ADHD challenges: procrastination loops, all-or-nothing thinking, emotional overwhelm, and self-talk. Each CBT course is practical and short, so you can apply it immediately in your planner, journal, habit tracker, and mood tracker.

6. AI guided meditations for focus & calm
Use AI guided meditations when you need a reset: before work, after stress, or during low-focus moments. Meditations are built to support attention, relaxation, and emotional regulation.

What you can do in Unique:
• ADHD journal for daily journaling
• Mood tracker (mood check-ins + notes)
• Planner & task planner for priorities
• Task tracker approach to follow-through
• Habit tracker for habits & routines
• CBT courses for ADHD tools
• AI guided meditations for calm & focus

Made for ADHD brains
Unique is for people who want an ADHD app that combines journal, planner, habit tracker, task planning, and mood tracking in one place. Track mood, plan tasks, build habits, and learn with CBT courses—one small step at a time.

description:
RoutineFlow is an ADHD planner and organizer that puts your success on autopilot by building a consistent daily routine with you. With this routine timer you can not only create a morning routine but organize your schedule for the entire week.

See for yourself using a smart routine timer can be a game-changer for managing ADHD or autism. Five reasons for why you should use an ADHD planner:

4. Stop ADHD procrastination with guided routine playlists

When starting to use this app for building a routine to manage ADHD or to manage autism, there are tons of templates available, like a morning routine or a study routine. name: ADHD Organizer: Llama Life
description:
Llama Life is a daily task planner and organizer, designed to help you focus on ONE task at a time - so you're not just making lists, you're actually getting THROUGH them!

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. The goal is to try and give a task 100% of our attention, until the timer runs out. This helps to increase focus, and gives us the mental space to think about ONE thing at a time.

Llama Life also let’s you know your total List Time, and the estimated finishing time, so you can be more aware of time passing, and plan your day.

We also love celebrating the wins, big or small, so very importantly, you get confetti (woo hoo!) when you finish a task. You can also personalize with color and emoji to get lots of variety and keep things fun and fresh!

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

I'm so glad you’re here, and are rooting for your success!

All the best,
Marie
Founder, Llama Life

What Is Dual NBack?

Dual NBack is an advanced memory training game where you track simultaneously both:
• Visual positions

Research suggests that consistent play may enhance your working memory—the ability to hold and process information briefly—and also boost short-term recall.

How to Play

Your task is to detect when the current stimulus matches what appeared N steps earlier.

If the current position or sound matches what was shown N turns ago, tap the corresponding button.

As your performance improves, the difficulty increases automatically — making every session both challenging and rewarding.

You can also manually adjust:
• N level
• Speed interval
• Session length

Train at your own pace and build real cognitive endurance.

Why Train Your Working Memory?

name: Accu​Battery
description:
Accu​Battery displays battery usage information, and measures battery capacity (mAh) based on science.
 
❤ BATTERY HEALTH
 
Batteries have a limited lifespan. Every time you charge your device, it wears out the battery, lowering its total capacity.

- Use our charge alarm to remind you to unplug your charger.
- Discover how much battery wear was endured during your charge session.
 
📊 BATTERY USE
 
Accu​Battery measures the actual battery usage using information from the battery charge controller. Battery usage per app is determined by combining these measurements with information on which app is in the foreground. Android calculates battery usage using pre-baked profiles that device manufacturers provide, like how much power the CPU uses. In practice however, these numbers tend to be highly inaccurate.
 
- Monitor how much battery your device is using
- Know how long you can use your device when it’s active or in standby mode
- Find out how much power each app uses.
- Check how often your device gets woken up from deep sleep.
 
🔌 CHARGE SPEED
 
Use Accu​Battery to find the fastest charger and USB cable for your device. Measure the charging current (in mA) to find out!
 
- Check how fast your device is charging when the screen is on or off.
- Know how long it takes to charge your phone and when it’s finished.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
 
- Measure real battery capacity (in mAh).
- See how much wear your battery sustains with each charge session.
- Look up the discharge speed and battery consumption per app.
- Remaining charge time - know how long it takes before your battery is charged.
- Remaining use time - know when you will run out of battery.
- Screen on or screen off estimations.
- Check the percentage of deep sleep, when the device is in standby mode.
- Ongoing notification for real time battery statistics at a glance.
 
🏆 PRO FEATURES
 
- Use Dark and AMOLED black themes to save energy.
- Access to historical sessions older than 1 day.
- Detailed battery statistics in notification.
- No ads
 
We're a small, independent app developer with a focus on quality and passion for battery statistics. AccuBattery doesn’t require access to privacy-sensitive information and doesn't make false claims. If you like the way we work, support us by upgrading to the Pro version.

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
If you live gluten-free (especially with celiac disease), you know the drill: eating out takes research, travel takes planning, and “GF-friendly” usually tells you nothing.

Gluten Dude helps you find gluten-free restaurants, read kitchen notes regarding cross-contact procedures, plan trips (driving + airports), and save money with gluten-free deals.

WHAT MAKES GLUTEN DUDE DIFFERENT
Most apps give you a giant list and call it a day. We don’t. Every listing is recommended, researched, and categorized so you can choose what feels right for you.

Filter restaurants by type:
• 100% Gluten-Free (dedicated gluten-free kitchens)
• Dude Vetted (recommended + researched, plus direct vetting notes from the kitchen)
• User Suggested (recommended + researched when the restaurant doesn’t respond)
• Chains (chains the community consistently rates highly)

Read notes from the kitchen:
For Dude Vetted places, you’ll see a “Dude Vetting Note” that tells you what matters: prep practices, shared equipment, and the real-world details you wish every restaurant would explain upfront.

Travel tools that actually help:
• Driving Trip Planner: find food along your route
• Custom filters: distance from route, restaurant type, cuisine
• Flying support: airport options by terminal (plus destination planning)

Save money living gluten-free:
Access exclusuive coupons, brand discounts, and online savings across a huge list of gluten-free products.

Updated constantly:
New restaurants, new deals, and new tools — without turning the app into a confusing mess.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Thank you for being an instrumental part of the celiac community. I trust your app so much more than any other." – Erica

"Nothing else I’ve seen has the breadth of up-to-date, peace-of-mind info on where to safely go." – GF Seeker

"I feel much more confident & safer using your app vs. any other. How diligent you are is what separates you from the rest." – Laura

"I won’t use any other app besides yours - because safety first!" - Kelly

ABOUT ME

I'm Scott, aka Gluten Dude. I was diagnosed with celiac in 2007 and started blogging in 2011 to help others navigate the same overwhelming path. For over 15 years, I’ve been advocating for this community, calling out the BS, raising awareness, and pushing for better support.

Five years ago, I launched this app to take that mission even further, giving you tools to travel, dine, and live gluten-free with more confidence and less stress. Now in 2026 I've rebuilt it to serve the gluten-free community even better.

Kind words from the Gluten-Free Community...

"Thank you for your answers, wisdom, support and humor. I could not live this life without you." - Susan

"Your knowledge and honesty is like a life raft in an unknown and terrifying ocean." - Jess

"Keep rockin’ Gluten Dude. You are changing the world for us." - Laura

"I appreciate all you try to do for all of us in the celiac community. Your ongoing and relentless support is such a gift. Thank YOU." - Hillary

Download the Gluten Dude app and take the guesswork out of gluten-free living.

Eat well. Travel smart. Save money.

Your gluten-free journey starts here.

name: Gluten Free: Rezepte & Magazin
description:
Über 1.500 Rezepte aus dem Gluten Free Magazin warten auf dich! Die vielfältigen Rezepte aus der Gluten Free Küche sowie von weiteren Glutenfrei-Profis zeigen dir, wie glutenfreies Backen und Kochen einfach gelingt und lecker schmeckt.

Bei den abwechslungsreichen Rezeptideen ist für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei! Die Vielfalt reicht von Brot und Brötchen über bunte Salate, regionale Klassiker und internationale Spezialitäten bis hin zu köstlichen Kuchen und Torten. Viele Rezepte sind vegetarisch oder vegan. Bei Backrezepten kommen mal fertige und mal eigene Mehlmischungen zum Einsatz.

Ob Einsteiger oder ambitionierter Hobby-Koch – die Gluten Free App begeistert alle, die alltagstaugliche, gelingsichere Rezepte suchen. Die detaillierten Anleitungen führen dich Schritt für Schritt durch die Zubereitung. Zu jedem Rezept findest du Zubereitungszeiten und Nährwertangaben sowie hilfreiche Tipps. Ob als Single oder für die ganze Familie: Mit dem Portionenrechner kannst du die Zutaten nach Belieben anpassen.

LASS DICH INSPIRIEREN
Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder neue Rezeptideen zum Backen und Kochen. Und unser Rezept des Tages bietet dir täglich neue Inspiration. Regelmäßig reinschauen lohnt sich!

GESUCHT, GEFUNDEN!
Du bist auf der Suche nach dem ultimativen Rezept für Pizza oder Zimtschnecken? Oder brauchst du eine Anregung, was du aus dem Kühlschrankinhalt zaubern kannst? Suche nach Stichwörtern oder Zutaten und passe mit dem Suchfilter die Ergebnisse individuell an – lasse dir z. B. nur vegane oder vegetarische Rezepte anzeigen oder schließe Zutaten aus, die du nicht verträgst, wie Ei, Milch oder Hefe. So findest du dein Wunschrezept noch einfacher!

DEINE FAVORITEN ALS KOCHBUCH
Speichere deine Lieblingsrezepte einfach in der App, so hast du dein eigenes Kochbuch immer dabei.

RATGEBER UND ALLTAGSTIPPS
Die Gluten Free App bietet mehr als nur Rezepte: Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder hilfreiche Artikel rund um den glutenfreien Alltag sowie Hintergrundinfos zu Zöliakie und zur glutenfreien Ernährung.

GLUTEN FREE ALS E-PAPER
Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo kannst du alle Ausgaben von Gluten Free als E-Paper lesen. Frischen Lesestoff gibt es alle zwei Monate mit einer neuen Ausgabe des Magazins.

TEST THE BEST
Entdecke und teste die Gluten Free App! Ohne Abo gibt es diese Funktionen kostenfrei für dich:
• Täglich ein neues Rezept des Tages
• 5 Rezepte der immer wieder neuen Rezeptsammlungen auf der Startseite
• Bis zu 5 Favoriten in deinem Kochbuch
• Redaktionelle Beiträge auf der Startseite

GLUTEN FREE PLUS
Du willst das komplette Angebot der Gluten Free App nutzen? Dann profitiere von den Premium-Vorteilen zum kleinen Preis! Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo (2,49 € im Monat oder 23,99 € im Jahr) hast du Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und Funktionen:
• Zugang zu allen Rezepten – aktuell über 1.500 (mit jeder neuen Gluten Free kommen weitere dazu)
• Unbegrenzt Lieblingsrezepte in dein Kochbuch speichern
• Alle Ausgaben des Gluten Free Magazins als E-Paper lesen

ÜBER GLUTEN FREE
Im Gluten Free Magazin dreht sich alles rund um die glutenfreie Ernährung. Seit 2017 erscheint das Magazin, inzwischen mit sechs Ausgaben jährlich, in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, in Luxemburg und Südtirol. Seit 2024 gibt es die Rezepte aus dem Gluten Free Magazin auch als App, die wie das Magazin vom frei & fein Verlag herausgegeben wird.

SUPPORT
Du hast eine technische Frage zur App oder ein Problem mit dem Abo? Dann schreibe uns an support@glutenfree-app.de. Wir helfen dir gern weiter!

Viel Spaß beim Kochen und Backen!
Dein Gluten Free Team

description:
Track what you eat. Track how you feel. Get insights on what to eat differently.

Eat Smart Kiwi helps you discover the effect of your eating on acne, bloating, stomach pain, headaches, energy levels, mood, or anything else you want to track. Every day, you record what you eat and how you feel, and we figure out all the correlations between the two. This helps you discover your personal allergies or intolerances, or simply how your body reacts to different foods and drinks.

In addition Eat Smart Kiwi lets you track exercise, sleep, weight, bowel movements, and anything else that may be relevant to your health.

After keeping a food and health diary, you'll get insights on what foods make your conditions worse, and what foods make them better, as well as the strength and significance of the correlation, whether others have experienced the same thing, and whether any scientific studies have been done on that particular food and condition. You will also get information on your typical nutrient intake if desired.

Track your energy levels, find which foods tend to reduce your headaches, improve your skin, or help with digestion problems. Use Eat Smart Kiwi to diagnose and discover how what you eat truly affects you.

Eat Smart Kiwi contains a built-in food database to make the entry process as painless as possible. Our analysis is enhanced with data about the cateogries and ingredients of each these foods. Your diary and insights will sync across all devices you are signed in to, including a browser.

Note that a small monthly subscription is required to the view the insights. The diary is free forever.
